stem: Water is drained from a tank through a valve at its base. The depth of the water in the tank, in centimeters, \(t\) minutes after the valve is opened is modeled by \(d(t) = 0.25(t - 20)^{2}\) for \(0 \le t \le 20\). According to the model, how many minutes after the valve is opened is the depth of the water 25 centimeters?
solution: Only \(t = 10\) is in the interval \(0 \le t \le 20\), so the answer is 10.
verify:
t = symbols('t')
s = [r for r in solve(Eq(Rational(1, 4)*(t - 20)**2, 25), t) if 0 <= r <= 20]
assert s == [10]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == s
